name: Web
description: Search the live web. Use this whenever the answer depends on current information, on anything after your training cutoff, or on a specific fact you are not certain of. Returns titles, URLs and short snippets. Follow up with web_fetch when a snippet is not enough.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the live web. Use this whenever the answer depends on current information, on anything after your training cutoff, or on a specific fact you are not certain of. Returns titles, URLs and short snippets. Follow up with web_fetch when a snippet is not enough.

query.description: The search query, phrased as you would type it into a search engine.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Retrieve one web page and read its text. Use it on a URL returned by web_search when the snippet does not answer the question. The page is stripped to readable text and truncated.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL, normally one that web_search returned.
